# Rate My Username

A free entertainment tool that rates username text with browser-side rules. It does not check availability, ownership, platform validity or trademark rights.

## Scoring
Each category is out of 100. The rounded overall score weights Vibe 27%, Originality 25%, Aura 28% and Memorability 20%. Signals include length, vowel balance, character diversity, digits, separators and repeat runs, with a deterministic seeded adjustment. Roast text is selected separately and can vary.

Core tools are usable without an account. Saving results and explicitly submitting a public leaderboard entry require sign-in. Guide suggestions are not checked for availability.
